//: Vercel deploys the frontend only. The API server has native deps
not viable in Vercel serverless functions:
- OCR bundle alone exceeds the 250MB unzipped Function limit
- Cold starts on native modules run 3-10s
- Long-running Anthropic streams and PDF parsing want a warm server
So the API lives on a container host (Fly.io / Railway / Render) and
the frontend calls it via VITE_API_BASE_URL at build time.
See infra/README.md for the API host runbook.
